g.text: Objective: drop a company that looks cheap for a reason, then decide whether it survives all three layers.

text.tspan: a trap detector failed
every failed detector is recorded
it is rejected by the rules
failed rules of every layer recorded
revenue_not_declining
average revenue growth over the last 3 years > −5%
average growth = mean of (current − previous) ÷ previous
uses the last four revenues (window + 1); fewer, or growth undefined through a base ≤ 0: fails
operating_margin_not_contracting
operating margin change (last − first) over up to the last 3 years (the last four margins) ≥ −200 basis points
fewer than two margins: fails
roic_above_sector_wacc
return on invested capital (ROIC) > sector weighted average cost of capital (WACC)
ROIC missing: fails
sector WACC missing: skipped (never after the coverage gate), and a skipped detector counts as failed
sloan_accruals_below
Sloan ratio (net income − operating cash flow) ÷ total assets < 0.1
missing figure or total assets ≤ 0: fails
share_count_not_diluting
average diluted share count growth ≤ 5% a year
fewer than two counts or a base ≤ 0 (growth undefined): fails
Comes out:
a survivor with its value, quality and growth inputs, or a rejected company with its failed rules

g.text: it is rejected [a quality gate failed, no value indicator passed, or a trap detector failed]
it is rejected [a quality gate failed, no value indicator passed, or a trap detector failed]

text.tspan: [skipped]
a skipped detector counts as failed

g.text: the run saves its rejected row
on to the ranking [always: only survivors are ranked]
